question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: - only at the next crossroads or junction
- at all crossroads and junctions on this road
- as far as the urban limit

correct_answers.text: - only at the next crossroads or junction

comment: This traffic sign grants you priority in a specific place. Thus, the right of way for the driver is limited and has no general validity.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: The start of an autobahn
The end of an autobahn
The start of a clearway for motor vehicles only

correct_answers.text: The start of an autobahn

comment: The traffic sign indicates that the motorway starts here. This also gives effect to all the rules that apply to this particular type of road.

question_text: What do the white markings on the road mean in this situation?

options.text: - highlight a duty to give-way due to the right-before-left rule
- indicate a traffic-calming zone
- are a warning about the poor state of the road surface

correct_answers.text: - highlight a duty to give-way due to the right-before-left rule

comment: At intersections and junctions with “right before left” regulation, especially in confusing places, are also used by waiting lines. Wartelinia are often used that look as similar to many small way to go-along.

question_text: What is the rule created by the road markings in this situation?

options.text: - approach the junction cautiously
- give way to the [red vehicle]
- come to a stop in front of the road markings

correct_answers.text: - approach the junction cautiously

comment:
You have to nourish yourself this intersection carefully, as it applies right to the left.
At intersections and junctions with “right before left” regulation, especially in confusing places, are also used by waiting lines. Wartelinia are often used that look as similar to many small way to go-along.

question_text: From which road sign onwards are you only allowed to drive at walking speed?
comment: In a traffic-calmed area, you may only drive your vehicle at walking speed, as you must expect pedestrians or children playing at any time.

question_text: At which traffic sign at the next junction do you generally have right of way?
comment: The traffic sign “One-time right of way” signals to you that you have the right of way at the next intersection or junction. However, this sign has no effect on the intersection after that.

question_text: Which traffic sign gives right of way at the next crossroads?

options.text: Traffic sign 1
Traffic sign 2
Traffic sign 3

correct_answers.text: Traffic sign 1

comment: Only the first traffic sign gives you right of way at the next intersection. The second traffic sign, however, indicates the end of the priority road and traffic sign number three regulates the right of way at a bottleneck.

question_text: Which traffic sign gives right of way?

options.text: Traffic sign 2
Traffic sign 1
Traffic sign 3

correct_answers.text: Traffic sign 2

comment: The correct traffic sign to observe the right of way is number two. Number one indicates that a dangerous turn is in front of the driver while number three indicates the number of a national highway.

question_text: What is allowed on priority roads outside built-up areas?

options.text: Stopping on the right edge of the roadway
Parking on the hard shoulder
Parking on the roadway

correct_answers.text: Stopping on the right edge of the roadway
Parking on the hard shoulder

comment: On priority roads outside of built-up areas, you may: 1. wait at the right side of the road; 2. park on a hard shoulder. On the other hand, parking on the road is prohibited. Parking vehicles constitute a hindrance and/or danger to flowing traffic, since vehicles are traveling much faster here than within the closed local area. Since a hard shoulder is not considered a lane, you may use it for parking. If there is a possibility to dodge on a hard shoulder, you should also use this for waiting shortly.

question_text: What ends here?

options.text: A priority road
A controlled parking zone
All previous zonal prohibitions

correct_answers.text: A priority road

comment: This traffic sign announces the change of a priority rule. It marks the end of the previous priority route. The signs "Give way" and "Stop! Give way!" that you can find on intersections and T-junctions, have a similar meaning.

question_text: What do you do when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: You may only take precedence when the narrowing is clear
You must be ready to stop despite taking precedence
You must give precedence to the oncoming traffic

correct_answers.text: You may only take precedence when the narrowing is clear
You must be ready to stop despite taking precedence

comment: The traffic sign gives you priority over oncoming traffic. The oncoming traffic is obliged to wait in front of the obstacle. Nevertheless, you must prepare for stopping when oncoming traffic is already in the bottleneck. You have to let those drivers drive out. You may proceed with right of way if the bottleneck is free.

question_text: What do these traffic signs allow?

options.text: Residents holding a parking licence with corresponding number may park here
All residents may use any of these parking spaces
Everybody may use this parking space as long as other parking spaces are still free

correct_answers.text: Residents holding a parking licence with corresponding number may park here

comment: This traffic sign indicates a parking lot that may only be used by residents with a correspondingly numbered parking pass. Other road users are not allowed to park there and have to switch to other parking places.

question_text: Are you allowed to park here?

options.text: Yes, as a seriously disabled person with an official parking permit
Yes, as a person accompanying blind persons with an official parking permit
Yes, briefly for shopping

correct_answers.text: Yes, as a seriously disabled person with an official parking permit
Yes, as a person accompanying blind persons with an official parking permit

comment: There are special parking spaces for people with impaired mobility or the blind. An official parking permit identifies the vehicles of these persons or their escorts. Even short parking on these areas is forbidden to other drivers.

question_text: What must you observe when parking here?

options.text: The parking time indicated on the parking ticket may not be exceeded
The parking ticket must be put in a place so it can be easily read when controlled
Parking ticket and parking disc rank equal

correct_answers.text: The parking time indicated on the parking ticket may not be exceeded
The parking ticket must be put in a place so it can be easily read when controlled

comment: In this parking lot you are only allowed to park with a valid ticket. Attach the parking ticket legibly behind the front or rear window of your car. Be sure not to exceed the parking time stated on the ticket. The parking disc does not replace the parking ticket: the parking disc is only valid if the parking meter is out of operation.

question_text: Which vehicles are allowed to park here?

options.text: Vehicles with a permissible total mass of up to 2.8 t
Motorcycles
Vehicles with a permissible total mass of more than 3.5 t

correct_answers.text: Vehicles with a permissible total mass of up to 2.8 t
Motorcycles

comment: The traffic sign regulates the parking situation for the road user. The sign allows parking partly on the sidewalk, the side strip and on the green verge for vehicles up to a total weight of 2.8 tons.

question_text: What must a motor vehicle's maximum speed, determined by its construction, be at least if you want to use this road?

options.text: 61 km/h
51 km/h
81 km/h

correct_answers.text: 61 km/h

comment: You must be able to achieve at least a maximum speed of 60 km/h on a motor road with your vehicle. The beginning of a motor road is always marked by a traffic sign.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A cul-de-sac
An underpass
A road closed to vehicle traffic

correct_answers.text: A cul-de-sac

comment: This is a dead end. You can drive normally in a dead end, but the road ends so you might have trouble to turn your car around to leave the street again.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A first aid station
A crossroads
A danger spot

correct_answers.text: A first aid station

comment: This traffic sign shows that a first aid station such as "Red Cross" or "Samaritan" is present at this point. However, it does not indicate any danger zone.

question_text: What must you remember when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: Street lighting does not stay on all night
Vehicles may be parked here all night without lights
Vehicles may not be parked here

correct_answers.text: Street lighting does not stay on all night

comment: If you see this sign at lanterns, then you have to secure your vehicle with your parking light. Since these lanterns are not lit up all night, it's very unsafe to leave an unlit car here.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A federal road (Bundesstraße)
Vehicles may not drive faster than 35 km/h
Vehicles must drive at least 35 km/h

correct_answers.text: A federal road (Bundesstraße)

comment: This traffic sign refers to a main road. The number stands for the number of the respective federal highway and not for example for a speed limit.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: An autobahn section which is normally not used very much
The place where the autobahn must be exited
An obligatory diversion for vehicles with dangerous goods

correct_answers.text: An autobahn section which is normally not used very much

comment: The diversion arrow points out to you as a car driver that you are on a traffic jam-prone section of the motorway and points out an alternative route. But you are not obliged to follow this.

question_text: During daylight, you enter a lit tunnel marked like this. What do you do?

options.text: I switch on the dipped headlights
I do not have to switch on the lights
I switch on the side lights

correct_answers.text: I switch on the dipped headlights

comment: As the car driver, you must turn on the low beam. The daytime lights are not enough, because the light conditions in the tunnel cannot be compared to daylight. You are obliged to make your vehicle seen.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: There may be a vehicle in the next emergency bay
In case of breakdown, you should stop in the emergency bay indicated
You may stop here to have a break

correct_answers.text: There may be a vehicle in the next emergency bay
In case of breakdown, you should stop in the emergency bay indicated

comment: This traffic sign shows you an emergency lay-by. There you can and should wait if you have a breakdown. It's possible that there's already a vehicle there. For breaks an emergency lay-by may not be used.

question_text: What do you have to do when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: Take off your sunglasses
Switch on dipped headlights
Switch on the hazard warning lights

correct_answers.text: Take off your sunglasses
Switch on dipped headlights

comment: This traffic sign is located in front of the entrance to a tunnel. Turn on the low beam and remove sunglasses for unrestricted visibility.

question_text: You drive into a brightly lit tunnel which is indicated like this. What do you do?

options.text: Drive with dipped headlights
Drive without lights
Drive with daytime running lights

correct_answers.text: Drive with dipped headlights

comment: Even a brightly lit tunnel cannot reach daylight conditions, so you need to drive in with low beam to make your vehicle recognizable. The daytime running light is simply not enough in this case.

question_text: What does this traffic sign combination indicate?

options.text: - a traffic-calming zone
- a pedestrian zone
- a children's playground

correct_answers.text: - a traffic-calming zone

comment: The traffic sign points to the end of the traffic-calming zone. Now higher speed rules apply again. As a car driver, you have no right of way when you leave and must be careful when entering.

question_text: What does this traffic road sign mean?

options.text: Priority road
No parking on the carriageway outside of settlements
Expressway

correct_answers.text: Priority road
No parking on the carriageway outside of settlements

comment: You drive on a priority road. The traffic sign is repeated at each intersection or T-junction where you have priority. Outside built-up areas, parking on priority roads is prohibited. On these roads people drive relatively fast and parking vehicles would be a hindrance or a threat.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A numbered diversion
Tram line no. 3
A numbered underground car park

correct_answers.text: A numbered diversion

comment: This traffic sign indicates a numbered detour. Since there are several detours, they are numbered. So, you know exactly where to drive.

question_text: What do you have to be aware of when you see this traffic sign combination?

options.text: If I am following the priority road, I have to signal a left-turn
If I continue driving straight ahead, I have to signal a right-turn
The direction of traffic to the left is prescribed

correct_answers.text: If I am following the priority road, I have to signal a left-turn

comment: The priority road is turning due to the additional sign. It's a turning priority road. If you stay on the priority road, you will need to indicate that. You have to take care of pedestrians crossing the street, if necessary, you have to stop. The answer: "Driving to the left is mandatory" is wrong, since this traffic sign does not dictate a direction of travel.

question_text: What is the correct action on roads with these types of protective cycle lanes?

options.text: - drive on the protective lanes when necessary, if there is no risk to cyclists
- in no event drive on the protective lanes
- use the protective lanes to assist parking

correct_answers.text: - drive on the protective lanes when necessary, if there is no risk to cyclists

comment: The directional sign indicates the safe area for cyclists. As the vehicle driver, you may only drive on the designated bicycle lane if a risk to cyclists is ruled out. Parking is strictly prohibited here.

question_text: What must you do upon seeing this traffic sign?

options.text: I must approach at a moderate speed if it is clear that pedestrians want to cross the road
I must allow the pedestrians to cross the road
I may not remain stationary on the pedestrian crossing if the traffic backs up

correct_answers.text: I must approach at a moderate speed if it is clear that pedestrians want to cross the road
I must allow the pedestrians to cross the road
I may not remain stationary on the pedestrian crossing if the traffic backs up

comment: On pedestrian crossings pedestrians have precedence, so vehicles should always drive at moderate speed and be ready to brake at any time. There's a strict restriction on overtaking at pedestrian crossings and with halting traffic it is forbidden to come to a stop at the crossing.

question_text: What must you be prepared for here?

options.text: That the flowing traffic will come to a stop
That children will cross the road more frequently than usual
That children will be playing on the road under supervision

correct_answers.text: That the flowing traffic will come to a stop
That children will cross the road more frequently than usual

comment: The traffic sign 'crossing guard', formerly school crossing guards, means that traffic assistance regulates traffic. They are allowed to stop traffic to allow children to cross the road. You need to be prepared for the flow of traffic to stop and for children to walk on the road more often than usual.

question_text: What applies according to this traffic sign?

options.text: I have to drive at walking speed
I may not impede pedestrians
I may only park on designated places

correct_answers.text: I have to drive at walking speed
I may not impede pedestrians
I may only park on designated places

comment: Within traffic calming zones you are allowed to travel at a maximum walking speed of 4 to 7 km/h, which means first gear, without giving gas. The street may be used completely by pedestrians. Children are allowed to play in the street. Be especially attentive and ready to brake. Pedestrians must not be impeded or endangered, you may have to wait. Since playing on the street is allowed here, you have to pay more attention to children. You are only allowed to park on marked areas.

question_text: What does this traffic sign combination mean to you?

options.text: I am on a priority road that bends left
I am not permitted to turn right or drive straight ahead
If I continue driving straight ahead, I have to allow right of way to vehicles arriving from the right

correct_answers.text: I am on a priority road that bends left

comment: The traffic sign indicates the course of the priority road. The additional sign indicates the bend to the left; if you follow this direction, you will still be on the priority road.

question_text: What do you have to be aware of when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: Children may play across the entire road
Motor vehicles have to drive at walking speed
Pedestrians are entitled to use the entire breadth of the road

correct_answers.text: Children may play across the entire road
Motor vehicles have to drive at walking speed
Pedestrians are entitled to use the entire breadth of the road

comment: For this question, all three answers are correct. In a "traffic calming zone", pedestrians may use the entire width of the street, children can play on the street and you may only drive at walking speed.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A customs point
A toll road
A prohibition on through-traffic

correct_answers.text: A customs point

comment: When you see this traffic sign, you approach a customs office. This means that you may encounter a traffic jam and therefore have to reduce your speed. You may also be controlled, so have all the papers at hand. Follow the instructions of the customs officers.

question_text: What is correct in this situation?

options.text: - a built-up area ends
- a built-up area starts
- a deviation ends

correct_answers.text: - a built-up area ends

comment: The village sign indicates the end of a closed village in the lower part. The upper part indicates the next town. You are standing on the left side of the road.

question_text: What do you have to observe in a traffic situation like this one?

options.text: - cross the centre line in order to pass by the obstruction
- cross the centre line in order to overtake
- not cross the centre line if this would endanger other traffic

correct_answers.text: - cross the centre line in order to pass by the obstruction
- cross the centre line in order to overtake
- not cross the centre line if this would endanger other traffic

comment: Guidelines have the task of separating the lanes. Therefore, you may only drive over them if you avoid obstacles or overtake vehicles. This is only allowed if no road user is endangered.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: An emergency stop and breakdown bay
A temporary additional carriageway
A stop for breaks and changing drivers

correct_answers.text: An emergency stop and breakdown bay

comment: If you are driving a vehicle, you may only stop in an emergency stop and breakdown bay in the event of an emergency or breakdown.

question_text: You are driving on a road that has a protective lane for cyclists. How may you use the protective lane?

options.text: - drive on the protective lane when necessary
- park on the protective lane
- stop on the protective lane

correct_answers.text: - drive on the protective lane when necessary

comment: You may use the cycle lane if necessary, provided you do not endanger or obstruct cyclists.
